headline.purpose: The one page title per screen. Newsreader.

body.purpose: Paragraphs and post body copy. System sans.

label.purpose: Nav links, meta lines, form labels, table headers, badges. System sans.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call to action (submit forms, primary admin actions).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-block; background: #b3521f; color: #fff; border: 1px solid #b3521f; padding: 10px 18px; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #8c3f17; border-color: #8c3f17; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Lower-emphasis action beside a primary button.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-block; background: transparent; color: #b3521f; border: 1px solid #b3521f; padding: 10px 18px; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgba(179, 82, 31, 0.08); color: #8c3f17; }

components.name: Post Card
components.description: One post preview in the home list, now image-forward with an optional category tag.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-post-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e5e2dd; border-radius: 10px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-post-cover { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 4/3; object-fit: cover; } .ds-post-card-body { padding: 20px 22px 22px; } .ds-post-card h2 { margin: 0 0 2px; font-family: 'Newsreader', Georgia, serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 1.4rem; } .ds-post-card h2 a { color: #1f2328; text-decoration: none; } .ds-post-card h2 a:hover { color: #b3521f; } .ds-meta { color: #6b7280; font-size: 0.85rem; margin: 0 0 10px; } .ds-read-more { color: #b3521f; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.92rem; text-decoration: none; } .ds-read-more:hover { text-decoration: underline; }

components.name: Cover Placeholder
components.description: Fills a post card or hero when no cover image was uploaded yet: a flat image glyph over a soft gradient tinted by the post's category color.
components.css: .ds-cover-placeholder { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; aspect-ratio: 4/3; } .ds-cover-placeholder svg { width: 44px; height: 44px; opacity: 0.7; } .ds-cover-placeholder.ds-tag-sage { background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(93% 0.03 145), #fff); color: oklch(58% 0.12 145); }

components.name: Badge
components.description: Small status pill, e.g. published/draft in the admin post list.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-block; padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: #eceae6; color: #6b7280; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-badge-ok { background: #e7f5ec; color: #14683a; }

components.name: Category Tag
components.description: One of five curated hues; marks a post's category on cards, hero, and the admin list.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-block; padding: 3px 12px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-tag-rust { background: rgba(179,82,31,0.12); color: #8c3f17; } .ds-tag-sage { background: oklch(93% 0.03 145); color: oklch(58% 0.12 145); } .ds-tag-blue { background: oklch(93% 0.02 235); color: oklch(58% 0.11 235); } .ds-tag-plum { background: oklch(93% 0.03 320); color: oklch(56% 0.13 320); } .ds-tag-gold { background: oklch(93% 0.03 80); color: oklch(60% 0.12 80); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Text/email/password field and select used across login and admin forms.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid #e5e2dd; border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; color: #1f2328; font: inherit; } .ds-input:focus { outline: 2px solid #b3521f; outline-offset: 1px; border-color: #b3521f; }

components.name: Color Picker
components.description: Category form's color swatches; one of the five curated hues, never a typed value.
components.html: <label class="ds-color-option ds-color-sage"><input type="radio" name="color" value="sage" checked></label>
components.css: .ds-color-option { width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 999px; display: inline-flex; border: 2px solid transparent; } .ds-color-option.ds-color-sage { background: oklch(58% 0.12 145); }

narrative.overview:
This is a quiet, personal system built to feel like a paper notebook, not a media outlet: a warm off-white page, one restrained accent, and hairline borders doing all the work that shadows usually do. Nothing raises its voice. The terracotta accent is spent sparingly — a link, a button, a badge — never a wash of color across a surface.

Buttons, cards, and fields are built to feel quiet and functional: they do their job without asking to be admired. The system was extended once, deliberately: posts can now carry a cover image and one category, so headlines and titles picked up a quiet serif (Newsreader) for warmth, and categories each get one hue-shifted color from the same restrained formula as the original accent. Everything else — the paper background, the hairline borders, the flat surfaces — was preserved as-is.
keyCharacteristics: Warm, near-white paper background with a single terracotta accent used rarely.
Completely flat — no shadows anywhere; separation comes from 1px hairline borders.
Two typefaces: a quiet serif for headlines/titles, the original sans for everything else.
Cards and post pages can carry a cover image; a calm icon placeholder fills the gap until one exists.
Category color is one of five curated hues, never a free-typed color.

rules.name: The Rare Rust Rule
rules.body: Ferrugem Quente appears in exactly one purposeful place per view — a button, a link, a badge. It never fills a background or covers more than a small control.

rules.name: The Five Hues Rule
rules.body: A category's color is always one of the five Category Palette hues, picked in the admin form's swatches — never a hex value typed by hand.

rules.name: The Two Face Rule
rules.body: Exactly two typefaces, each locked to a role: Newsreader for Headline and Title, the system sans for Body and Label. Never a third face, and never Newsreader for body copy.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: No box-shadow is used anywhere. Depth is never simulated; two adjacent surfaces are told apart by a 1px border and a subtle background-tone shift, nothing else.

dos: Do keep Ferrugem Quente rare — one accent moment per view, never a background fill.
Do use the 1px hairline border as the only tool for separating surfaces; never simulate depth with shadow.
Do keep Newsreader locked to Headline/Title and the sans locked to Body/Label.
Do pick category color only from the five Category Palette swatches, never a typed hex.
Do show a flat icon placeholder for a missing cover image — never a fabricated photo.
donts: Don't add box-shadow anywhere in this system.
Don't introduce a third typeface, or use Newsreader for body copy.
Don't use a border radius outside 8px, 10px, or the 999px pill.
Don't invent a category-specific illustration — categories are user-created and open-ended, so the placeholder stays generic.
